mapper.sql: center_seq, center_name, center_type_cd, center_addr_1, center_addr_2, zip_code, latitude, longitude, total_area, contact_num, manager_name, usage_yn, created_at, creator_seq, modified_at, modifier_seq
mapper.update: UPDATE t_center SET center_name = #{centerName}, center_type_cd = #{centerTypeCd}, center_addr_1 = #{centerAddr1}, center_addr_2 = #{centerAddr2}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, total_area = #{totalArea}, contact_num = #{contactNum}, manager_name = #{managerName}, usage_yn = #{usageYn}, modified_at = #{modifiedAt}, modifier_seq = #{modifierSeq} WHERE center_seq = #{centerSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT a.center_seq, a.center_name, a.center_type_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'CenterType' AND com_code_cd = a.center_type_cd) AS center_type_cd_name, a.center_addr_1, a.center_addr_2, a.zip_code, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.total_area, a.contact_num, a.manager_name, a.usage_yn, a.created_at, a.creator_seq, b.admin_name as creator_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_vehicle x WHERE x.center_seq = a.center_seq) as vehicle_count FROM t_center a LEFT JOIN t_admin b ON a.creator_seq = b.admin_seq WHERE a.center_seq = #{centerSeq}

SELECT a.center_seq, a.center_name, a.center_type_cd, (SELECT com_code_name FROM t_common_code WHERE com_code_group_cd = 'CenterType' AND com_code_cd = a.center_type_cd) AS center_type_cd_name, a.center_addr_1, a.center_addr_2, a.zip_code, a.total_area, a.contact_num, a.manager_name, a.usage_yn, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_vehicle x WHERE x.center_seq = a.center_seq) as vehicle_count FROM t_center a
AND a.center_name LIKE '%' || #{centerName} || '%'
AND a.center_type_cd = #{centerTypeCd}
AND a.manager_name LIKE '%' || #{managerName} || '%'
